PrestCribe turns scanned records from the University of Melbourne Archives into checked, searchable data.

## Install

**Windows:** in PowerShell, run

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy ByPass -c "irm https://github.com/bennos280/IT-Project-Unimelb-Archive-Team-4/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex"
```

**Mac** (macOS 14 or later): in Terminal, run

```sh
curl -LsSf https://github.com/bennos280/IT-Project-Unimelb-Archive-Team-4/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh
```

PrestCribe then opens, and is in your Start menu or Applications. Run the same line again to update; your work is kept.

## Try it

On PrestCribe's home page, choose **Open a PrestCribe file** and pick one of these:

- `wilfred-prest-survey.prestcribe`: the survey set up, ready to read
- `wilfred-prest-survey-with-transcriptions.prestcribe`: 26 items already read (80 MB), ready to review

To read pages, sign in to Claude Code or Codex, or add an API key, in **Settings**.

Built by COMP30022 Team 4 for the University of Melbourne Archives.
